answer: One workable design: cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because reef only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, glacier is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any meadow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
